messages:
anya: heads-up — starting a small migration to run a rootless sandbox for image rebuilds in staging. need to coordinate RBAC + KMS access for the new runner. TL;DR: want to avoid broad cluster-level KMS roles.

jordan: +1. what's the runner identity? service account or node pool?

anya: new SA: infra-rebuild-rootless@redwood-inference. Needs decrypt-only for envelope keys in projects/rebuilds. No signer perms.

sam: prefer to bind a limited role via namespace-scoped WorkloadIdentity (GKE) — avoids granting at cluster scope. Can we use KMS IAM role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`?

lee: yep decrypter is fine. Also we should ensure audit logs include which SA used the key: enable 'Data Access' logs on the key resource. @security-oncall can confirm retention.

security-oncall: confirm — enable Data Access for KMS, export to audit-bucket (gs://redwood-audit-kms) and to BigQuery for querying. Retain 90 days by default; compliance may request 1yr for rebuild artifacts. Add key labels: `env=staging`, `pipeline=rebuilds`.

anya: thanks. question on RBAC: during rollout I'll need to run a 'one-off' manual decrypt from my laptop. what's the safest pattern?

jordan: use temporary short-lived credentials via service account impersonation: `gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=infra-rebuild-rootless@...` don't add personal long-lived keys.

sam: or use `gcloud auth application-default login --impersonate-service-account=...` in a throwaway terminal. Avoid storing any plaintext keys in CI or home dir.

devops-bot: pipeline triggered: `rebuild-rootless-staging` — pod template: `image-builder:staging-rootless:v2` created.

lee: runtime hardening for the sandbox: seccomp profile + no-new-privs. In manifests add: `securityContext: { runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] } }` and mount tmpfs for /tmp.

anya: noted. also cosign flow: can someone confirm cosign keywrap with KMS? quick example: `COSIGN_PASSWORD=... cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/attest-prod/locations/us/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/signer image:tag`

jordan: cosign + KMS works. signing will need `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on that key. For staging we should avoid giving signer rights to the rebuild runner — use an external signing service or a separate SA in a different project.

security-oncall: agreed. keep signing keys in a central project with restricted signers. Add an ACL review to the rebuild runbook. If we cross-project-wrap keys, document rotation windows and who can revoke.

anya: plan: create SA, grant decrypter in staging project, enable Data Access logs on KMS key, add seccomp + drop caps in pod spec, and use cosign with external signer for prod. rolling out Wednesday 11:00 PT. Any blockers?

sam: infra ok. I'll open the RBAC PR with the least-privilege role and attach the YAML.

lee: I'll add the seccomp profile and a small e2e that checks `capabilities` and `no_new_privs`.

security-oncall: I'll add the audit export, retention policy, and update the runbook steps for incident triage (what to check in audit logs). Ping me when PRs are up for approval.

anya: awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
